lessons.title: Tanishuvni boshlash
lessons.focus: Introductions · be (I/you)
lessons.goal: O‘zingizni tanishtiring va be bilan sodda savol-javob qiling.
lessons.teach: Hello, I'm ... / Hi, I'm ... Nice to meet you. — And you. Are you here on business or on holiday? — No, I'm not. I'm here to study.
lessons.practice: 🎭 Uch rol kartasidan birini tanlang (sayyoh, talaba, xizmat safari). Salomlashib, ismingizni ayting va sherigingizdan nima maqsadda kelganini so‘rang.

lessons.title: Qayerdansiz?
lessons.focus: Countries · numbers 1–10 · be (we/you)
lessons.goal: Mamlakat va shaharingizni ayting, boshqa odamdan qayerdanligini so‘rang.
lessons.teach: I'm from Uzbekistan. I'm from Tashkent. — Where are you from? We're from Brazil. Numbers: one–ten. Use I'm / we're and are you / are we.
lessons.practice: 🗺️ Xaritadan ikki mamlakat tanlang. Har biri uchun Where are you from? dialogini tuzing va 1–10 sonlarini inglizcha ayting.
quiz: Are you from Brazil? — No, I ___.

lessons.title: Ismni qanday harflaysiz?
lessons.focus: The alphabet · What/Where/How questions
lessons.goal: Ismni harflab ayting va anketa uchun asosiy ma'lumotni so‘rang.
lessons.teach: What's your name? How do you spell that? Where are you from? What's your phone number? Mashq uchun telefon raqami va harf nomlarini sekin, aniq ayting.
lessons.practice: 🔤 Ism kartangizni sherigingizga ko‘rsatmang. Ismingizni harflab ayting; u yozsin, keyin tekshirib, How do you spell it? savolini bering.

lessons.title: Gapirish va yozish: tanishuv
lessons.focus: Greetings · saying goodbye · filling in a form
lessons.goal: Tanishuvni yakunlang va oddiy anketa ma'lumotini yozing.
lessons.teach: Hello / Hi; Nice to meet you. — And you. Goodbye / See you. Form: first name, surname, country, city and phone number.
lessons.practice: 🪪 O‘zingiz uchun inglizcha mini-anketa to‘ldiring va 5 replikali tanishuv dialogi tuzing. Telefon raqami haqiqiy bo‘lishi shart emas.
quiz: ‘Are you here to study?’ uchun ijobiy qisqa javob
‘How do you spell that?’ nimani so‘raydi?

lessons.title: Bu inglizchada nima?
lessons.focus: Objects · singular/plural · this/that/these/those · be (it/they)
lessons.goal: Buyumlarni birlik va ko‘plikda, yaqin yoki uzoqligiga qarab ko‘rsating.
lessons.teach: What's this? — It's a key. What's that? — It's an umbrella. What are these? — They're pens. What are those? — They're books. Ko‘p oddiy otlarga -s qo‘shiladi.
lessons.practice: 🧳 Yaqinga ikki buyum, uzoqroqqa yana ikki buyum qo‘ying. This/that/these/those bilan to‘rtta savol-javob tuzing.

lessons.title: Kasbingiz nima?
lessons.focus: Jobs · be (he/she/it/they) · numbers 11–100
lessons.goal: Kasb va raqamlarni ayting, be fe'lining he/she/they shakllarini ishlating.
lessons.teach: What's her job? — She's a nurse. He's an engineer. They're teachers. Is he a taxi driver? — No, he isn't. 11–100 sonlarini ayting va -teen/-ty urg‘usiga e'tibor bering.
lessons.practice: 🧑‍⚕️ Uch kasb kartasini tanlang. Har biri haqida He/She is a ... deb gap tuzing; 13 va 30 kabi sonlarni farqlab ayting.
quiz: Is he a doctor? — No, he ___.

lessons.title: Ular qayerda?
lessons.focus: Subject pronouns · in/on/near/next to
lessons.goal: Ism o‘rnidagi olmoshlar va joy predloglari bilan odamlar hamda buyumlarni toping.
lessons.teach: I/you/he/she/it/we/they names o‘rnida keladi. The keys are on the table. The phone is in the bag. The station is near the hotel.
lessons.practice: 🗺️ Xona sxemasiga 4 buyumni joylang. It/they olmoshlari va in/on/near/next to bilan qayerdaligini ayting.
quiz: Ali and Sara are here. ___ are students.

lessons.title: Gapirish va yozish: vaqt va blog
lessons.focus: Wh- questions · telling the time · a simple blog
lessons.goal: Oddiy savollar va vaqtni takrorlab, o‘zingiz haqingizda qisqa blog yozing.
lessons.teach: Who is he? Where are your keys? What time is it? — It's half past four. Blogda ismingiz, ishingiz/o‘qishingiz, shahringiz va bitta yoqtirgan narsangizni yozing.
lessons.practice: 🕵️ Uchta buyum yoki odam haqida Who/What/Where bilan savol bering. So‘ng xayoliy uchrashuv vaqtini soat bilan aytib, 4 jumlali blog yozing.
quiz: ___ are your keys? — On the desk.

units.title: Odamlar va ularning buyumlari
units.theme: Qo‘shnilar, egalik, oila va kundalik iboralar

lessons.title: Qo‘shnilar
lessons.focus: Adjective + noun · irregular plurals · have got/has got
lessons.goal: Sifatli ot birikmalari va have got bilan odam hamda narsalarni tasvirlang.
lessons.teach: a friendly neighbour; an expensive phone; two children; three people. I've got a friendly neighbour. She's got two children. Sifat odatda otdan oldin keladi.
lessons.practice: 🏘️ Uch qo‘shniga qisqa tavsif yozing. Sifat+ot, have got va people/children kabi irregular plural ishlating.

lessons.title: Buyumlarim
lessons.focus: have got/has got · negatives and questions
lessons.goal: Egalikni ijobiy, inkor va savol shaklida ifoda qiling.
lessons.teach: I've got a bike. He has got a camera. We haven't got a car. Has she got a laptop? — Yes, she has. / No, she hasn't.
lessons.practice: 🎒 Sumkamda nima bor? ro‘yxati tuzing: 3 ta bor, 2 ta yo‘q. Keyin sherigingizdan Have you got...? deb so‘rang.

lessons.title: Oila
lessons.focus: Possessive determiners · possessive 's · family
lessons.goal: Oila a'zolarini my/his/her/our va apostrof-s bilan tanishtiring.
lessons.teach: This is my sister. His parents are friendly. Sara's husband is Ali. Apostrophe + s egalikni bildiradi: Malika's house.
lessons.practice: 🌳 Xayoliy oila daraxtini chizing. To‘rt kishini This is my... bilan tanishtirib, ikki marta possessive 's ishlating.
quiz: Have you got a car? — No, I ___.

lessons.title: Gapirish va yozish: ijtimoiy tarmoq xabari
lessons.focus: Opposite adjectives · everyday expressions · social media message
lessons.goal: Qarama-qarshi sifatlar va kundalik iboralar bilan qisqa xabar yozing.
lessons.teach: The flat is small but comfortable. The neighbours are friendly. Thanks very much! — You're welcome. And qo‘shimcha, but qarama-qarshi fikrni bog‘laydi.
lessons.practice: 💬 Oila yoki qo‘shni haqida 4 jumlali post yozing. And/but, qarama-qarshi sifat va tabiiy javob iborasini ishlating.

units.title: Mening hayotim
units.theme: Kundalik hayot, qatnov, kun tartibi va do‘kondagi suhbat

lessons.title: Kundalik hayot
lessons.focus: Present simple positive
lessons.goal: Har kuni bajaradigan ishlarni aytish
lessons.teach: I work in a school. We live in Tashkent. He works in an office. She studies English. He/she/it fe'lida ko‘pincha -s qo‘shiladi.
lessons.practice: ⏰ Kun tartibi rasmlarini to‘g‘ri ketma-ketlikka qo‘ying va 5 ta ‘I …’ gap tuzing.

lessons.title: Safar va qatnov
lessons.focus: Transport · present simple negative
lessons.goal: Qatnov odatlari va qilmaydigan ishlaringizni don't/doesn't bilan ayting.
lessons.teach: I go to work by bus. I don't drive. He doesn't travel by train. Don't I/you/we/they bilan, doesn't he/she/it bilan keladi; undan keyin fe'lning oddiy shakli ishlatiladi.
lessons.practice: 🚌 Ikki kishining qatnovini taqqoslang. Qaysi transportda borishini va nimalar qilmasligini 4 gapda yozing; don't/doesn't ikkalasini ishlating.

lessons.title: Mening kunim
lessons.focus: Daily activities · present simple yes/no questions
lessons.goal: Do/Does yordamida kun tartibi haqida savol bering va qisqa javob qaytaring.
lessons.teach: Do you get up at seven? — Yes, I do. Does she have breakfast at home? — No, she doesn't. Does bilan asosiy fe'lga -s qo‘shilmaydi.
lessons.practice: ⏰ Kun tartibi jadvalini to‘ldiring. Sherigingizga Do you...? bilan uch savol bering va Yes, I do / No, I don't bilan javob bering.
quiz: Do they work here? — No, they ___.

lessons.title: Mening haftam
lessons.focus: Short informal email; everyday situations
lessons.goal: Kundalik hayot haqida qisqa email yozish
lessons.teach: Hi Sam, I usually get up at seven. I go to work by bus. I don't work on Sundays. What do you do at weekends?
lessons.practice: ✉️ Do‘stingizga 5 jumlali email yozing. Bir kun tartibi, bitta inkor, bitta savol bo‘lsin.
quiz: I ___ watch TV in the morning. (hech qachon)

units.title: Uslub va dizayn
units.theme: Kiyim, arxitektura, tashqi ko‘rinish va sayohat ma'lumoti

lessons.title: Kiyim uslubi
lessons.focus: Colours and clothes · adverbs of frequency
lessons.goal: Kiyimlarni rang bilan tasvirlang va qanchalik tez-tez kiyishingizni ayting.
lessons.teach: I usually wear a blue shirt. She sometimes wears a jacket. Chastota ravishi asosiy fe'ldan oldin keladi: I often wear... Be fe'lidan keyin keladi: It is always comfortable.
lessons.practice: 👕 Haftaning uch kuni uchun kiyim tanlang. Har birini rang bilan tasvirlab, usually/sometimes/never dan kamida ikkitasini ishlating.
quiz: I ___ wear a jacket in winter. (odatda)

lessons.title: Ajoyib arxitektura
lessons.focus: Adjectives · Wh- questions · very/really
lessons.goal: Yoqtirgan binongizni sifatlar bilan tasvirlab, Wh- savollar bering.
lessons.teach: It's a very modern building. It's really beautiful. What does it look like? Where is it? Why do you like it? Very/really sifatdan oldin keladi.
lessons.practice: 🏛️ Xayoliy bino rasmini tasavvur qiling. Uch sifat bilan tasvirlab, What/Where/Why savollaridan ikkitasiga javob yozing.
quiz: ___ do you like the building? — Because it's unusual.

lessons.title: Dunyo bo‘ylab uslublar
lessons.focus: Parts of the body · present simple all forms
lessons.goal: Tashqi ko‘rinish va uslub haqida ijobiy, inkor va savol shaklida gapiring.
lessons.teach: She has long hair and blue eyes. Do you wear traditional clothes? He doesn't wear a hat. Does she like this style? Present simplening ijobiy, inkor va savol shakllarini takrorlang.
lessons.practice: 🌍 Ikki xayoliy insonning kiyimi va tashqi ko‘rinishini taqqoslang. Bitta ijobiy, bitta inkor va bitta Do/Does savol yozing.
quiz: He ___ wear a hat at work.

lessons.title: Gapirish va yozish: safar ma'lumoti
lessons.focus: Asking/giving travel information · arrangements by text
lessons.goal: Yo‘l, vaqt va uchrashuvni aniqlashtirib, qisqa xabar almashing.
lessons.teach: Where does the bus leave from? What time does it arrive? Let's meet at six. — Great! Xabarda uchrashuv joyi va vaqtini aniq ko‘rsating.
lessons.practice: 🚆 Xayoliy safar jadvalidan foydalaning. Jo‘nash joyi/vaqtini so‘rab-javob qiling va uchrashuvni kelishuvchi ikki SMS yozing.

units.title: Joylar va qulayliklar
units.theme: Shahar, mehmonxona, xonalar va muammolarni tushuntirish

lessons.title: Ikki shahar
lessons.focus: Places in a town · there is/there are
lessons.goal: Shahardagi joylarni birlik va ko‘plikda tasvirlang.
lessons.teach: There's a museum near the station. There are two cafés in the town. There is birlik, there are ko‘plikdagi narsalar uchun ishlatiladi.
lessons.practice: 🏙️ Ikki xayoliy shahar xaritasini tuzing. Har birida There is va There are bilan gap yozib, farqini tushuntiring.
quiz: There ___ a station in my village.

lessons.title: Wi-Fi bormi?
lessons.focus: Hotel facilities · Is there...? / Are there...?
lessons.goal: Mehmonxona qulayliklarini so‘rang va qisqa javob bering.
lessons.teach: Is there Wi-Fi? — Yes, there is. Are there any lifts? — No, there aren't. Is there birlik, Are there ko‘plik uchun ishlatiladi.
lessons.practice: 🏨 Resepshnda Wi-Fi, lift va boshqa qulayliklar haqida to‘rtta savolli suhbat yozing; qisqa javoblarni ham qo‘shing.

lessons.title: Har bir xonadonda oshxona bormi?
lessons.focus: Rooms/furniture · each and all the
lessons.goal: Xonalar va jihozlarni tasvirlab, each va all the ni ishlating.
lessons.teach: Each flat has a kitchen. All the rooms have a window. Yotoqxona, oshxona va mehmonxona jihozlarini sodda gaplar bilan tasvirlang.
lessons.practice: 🛋️ Uch xonali uy rejasini chizing. Each bilan bitta, all the bilan bitta gap va mebel nomlari bilan yana ikkita gap yozing.
quiz: The lamp is next to the bed.

lessons.title: Gapirish va yozish: mehmonxona sharhi
lessons.focus: Explaining problems · writing a hotel review
lessons.goal: Mehmonxonadagi muammoni muloyim tushuntiring va qisqa sharh yozing.
lessons.teach: Excuse me, there's a problem with the shower. It doesn't work. Could you help, please? Sharhda bitta yaxshi jihat va bitta muammoni ayting.
lessons.practice: 🧳 Mehmon va resepshn xodimi bo‘lib 4 replikali dialog yozing. So‘ng qulaylik, muammo va umumiy bahoni beruvchi 4 jumla yozing.
quiz: There isn't any hot water in the room.

units.title: Ko‘nikmalar va qiziqishlar
units.theme: Qobiliyat, iltimos, hobbi va ijtimoiy tarmoq posti

lessons.title: U rasm chiza oladi
lessons.focus: Skills · can/can't
lessons.goal: Qila oladigan va qila olmaydigan ishlaringizni ayting.
lessons.teach: I can swim, but I can't paint. She can sing. Can/can't dan keyin fe'lning oddiy shakli keladi; can bilan he/she uchun -s qo‘shilmaydi.
lessons.practice: 🎨 O‘zingiz va xayoliy do‘st uchun ko‘nikmalar jadvali tuzing. Har biri haqida uchtadan can/can't gap yozing.

lessons.title: Yordam bera olasizmi?
lessons.focus: Can you...? · adverbs of manner · simple requests
lessons.goal: Qobiliyatni so‘rang, muloyim iltimos qiling va harakatni ravish bilan tasvirlang.
lessons.teach: Can you cook? — Yes, I can. Can you help me, please? She paints carefully. Quickly/well/carefully harakat qanday bajarilishini bildiradi.
lessons.practice: 🤝 Uchta vaziyat uchun muloyim Can you...? iltimos tuzing. Javoblarda well/quickly/carefully dan foydalaning.

lessons.title: Men tashqariga chiqishni yoqtiraman
lessons.focus: Hobbies · like/love/hate + -ing
lessons.goal: Hobbi va yoqtirishlarni fe'lning -ing shakli bilan ayting.
lessons.teach: I like going out. He loves playing chess. They hate waiting. Like/love/hate dan keyin fe'lga -ing qo‘shiladi.
lessons.practice: 🎲 Hobbi tanlang va like/love/hate + -ing bilan uch gap tuzing. Sherigingizdan Do you like ...ing? deb so‘rang.

lessons.title: Gapirish va yozish: ijtimoiy tarmoq posti
lessons.focus: Simple requests · writing a social media post
lessons.goal: Muloyim iltimos qiling va qiziqishingiz haqida qisqa post yozing.
lessons.teach: Could you open the window, please? Can you help me? Postda hobbi yoki noodatiy mashg‘ulotni tanishtirib, do‘stona taklif qo‘shing.
lessons.practice: 📱 Qiziqishingiz haqida 4 jumlali post yozing. Like + -ing, can/can't va bitta muloyim iltimosni qo‘shing.

units.title: O‘tmishimiz
units.theme: O‘tmishdagi holatlar, voqealar, object pronouns va tarjimai hol

lessons.title: Yetti yoshimizda
lessons.focus: Dates · past be (was/were)
lessons.goal: O‘tmishdagi yosh, sana va joy haqida was/were bilan gapiring.
lessons.teach: I was seven in 2015. We were at school. Was she happy? — Yes, she was. Was I/he/she/it bilan, were you/we/they bilan ishlatiladi.
lessons.practice: 📅 Xayoliy bola uchun uch sana belgilang. Was/were bilan o‘sha paytdagi yoshi, joyi va holati haqida gap yozing.

lessons.title: O‘tmishdagi hayotlar
lessons.focus: was born/died · regular past simple verbs
lessons.goal: Tarjimai hol faktlari va regular fe'llar bilan o‘tmishdagi hayotni ayting.
lessons.teach: She was born in 1998. He died in 2010. They lived in a small town and worked at a school. Regular past fe'llarga -ed qo‘shiladi; talaffuzi /t/, /d/ yoki /ɪd/ bo‘lishi mumkin.
lessons.practice: 📰 Xayoliy inson haqida 5 faktli mini-biografiya yozing. Was born, lived/worked va ikkita sanani ishlating.
quiz: We ___ in a café last night.

lessons.title: Muhim lahzalar
lessons.focus: Object pronouns · past time phrases · special occasions
lessons.goal: Object pronouns bilan muhim voqeani ayting va suhbatdoshga qiziqish bildiring.
lessons.teach: I met Sara yesterday. I called her. We invited them last year. Object pronouns: me, you, him, her, it, us, them. Qiziqish bildiring: Really? That's great! Oh no!
lessons.practice: 🎉 Tug‘ilgan kun, to‘y yoki bitiruv voqeasini tanlang. To‘rt gapda kamida ikkita object pronoun ishlating va suhbatdoshning qiziqish bildiruvchi javobini qo‘shing.
quiz: We invited Ali and Malika. We invited ___.

lessons.title: Gapirish va yozish: tarjimai hol
lessons.focus: Special occasions · showing interest · biography
lessons.goal: Muhim sana va voqealarni tartiblab, sodda tarjimai hol yozing.
lessons.teach: He was born in 2001. She moved to Tashkent in 2018. O‘tgan zamon iboralari va sanalarni ishlating; voqealarni vaqt tartibida yozing.
lessons.practice: 🧑‍🚀 Haqiqiy yoki xayoliy inson haqida 5 jumlali biografiya yozing. Tug‘ilgan yil, o‘tgan ikkita voqea va qiziqish bildiruvchi iborani kiriting.
quiz: Qaysi biri o'tgan voqeani vaqt tartibida beradi?

units.title: G‘ayrioddiy hikoyalar
units.theme: Xotiralar, irregular verbs, ob-havo va tadbir sharhi

lessons.title: Quvonchli xotiralar
lessons.focus: Past simple irregular verbs · adjective + noun
lessons.goal: Irregular fe'llar bilan esda qolgan voqeani qisqa aytib bering.
lessons.teach: I went to the park, saw a strange bird and took a photo. We had a great day. Irregular forms: go/went, see/saw, take/took, have/had.
lessons.practice: 📸 Went/saw/had/found/met/took fe'llaridan uchtasini tanlang. Ulardan foydalanib to‘rt jumlali xotira yozing.

lessons.title: Yaxshi bahona
lessons.focus: Past simple negatives and questions
lessons.goal: Did/didn't bilan o‘tgan voqeani so‘rang va inkor qiling.
lessons.teach: Did you call? — No, I didn't. She didn't see the message. Did/didn't dan keyin fe'lning oddiy shakli keladi: Did you go?
lessons.practice: 🕵️ Sirli voqea uchun Did...? shaklida uch savol tuzing. Ikki javobni didn't bilan yozing; fe'lni oddiy shaklda qoldiring.

lessons.title: Yangilik hikoyalari
lessons.focus: Ago · verb phrases · past time expressions
lessons.goal: Qachon sodir bo‘lganini ago bilan aytib, voqeani ketma-ket bayon qiling.
lessons.teach: It happened two days ago. I went out, met a friend and found a wallet. First/then/finally kabi ketma-ketlik iboralari hikoyani tushunarli qiladi.
lessons.practice: 📰 Xayoliy yangilik yozing: voqeani ago bilan vaqtga bog‘lang va first/then/finally yordamida to‘rt gapda ayting.

lessons.title: Gapirish va yozish: ob-havo va tadbir sharhi
lessons.focus: Talking about the weather · event review
lessons.goal: Ob-havoni tasvirlang va o‘tgan tadbirga qisqa baho bering.
lessons.teach: It was rainy and windy. The concert started late, but the music was great. Sharhda tadbir, ob-havo, fikringiz va sababini yozing.
lessons.practice: 🌦️ Ochiq havodagi tadbir haqida 5 jumlali sharh yozing. Ob-havo, past simple va because bilan bitta sabab kiriting.
quiz: Sharhda fikrni sabab bilan bog‘lash uchun

units.title: Yangi joylar, yangi loyihalar
units.theme: Kelajak rejalari, hayotdagi o‘zgarish, kafe va takliflar

lessons.title: 5000 funt yig‘moqchimiz
lessons.focus: Going to · positive/negative · future time phrases
lessons.goal: Kelajak rejasi va amalga oshirmoqchi bo‘lmagan ishni ayting.
lessons.teach: We're going to raise £5,000. I'm going to help. He isn't going to travel next week. Use be + going to + base verb for plans.
lessons.practice: 💡 Kichik ijtimoiy loyiha tanlang. 3 ta going to reja va 1 ta going to inkor gap bilan maqsadingizni taqdim eting.

lessons.title: Yangi hayot
lessons.focus: Going to questions · short answers · life changes
lessons.goal: Kelajak rejalari haqida going to bilan savol bering va qisqa javob qaytaring.
lessons.teach: Are you going to move? — Yes, I am. Is she going to study? — No, she isn't. Yangi uy, ish yoki safar kabi hayotdagi o‘zgarishlar haqida gapiring.
lessons.practice: 🧭 Yangi joyga ko‘chayotgan xayoliy insonni tanlang. Are you going to...? bilan to‘rt savol-javob tuzing.
quiz: ___ you going to move next month?
Is she going to study? — Yes, she ___.
They ___ going to travel this year.

lessons.title: Kafe shaharlari
lessons.focus: Cafe food · would like · ordering food and drink
lessons.goal: would like yordamida xohishni bildirib, kafeda buyurtma bering.
lessons.teach: I'd like a coffee, please. I'd like to try the local cake. Would you like some water? Use would like + noun or to + verb for a polite choice.
lessons.practice: ☕ Menyudan uchta narsa tanlang. Mijoz va ofitsiant bo‘lib kamida 5 replikali buyurtma dialogi yozing.

lessons.title: Gapirish va yozish: taklif va minnatdorchilik
lessons.focus: Invitations · thank-you notes · unit review
lessons.goal: Taklif va minnatdorchilik xati yozib, bo‘lim ko‘nikmalarini jamlang.
lessons.teach: Would you like to join us? Let's meet at the weekend. Thank you for inviting me. Taklifda nima, qayerda va qachonligini yozing; javobda minnatdorchilik bildiring.
lessons.practice: ✉️ Yangi loyihangiz tadbiriga taklif yozing va unga qisqa javob qaytaring. So‘ng tanishuv, kafe buyurtmasi va kelajak rejalarini bitta final dialogda birlashtiring.
quiz: Would you like to join us?
We're going to start a project.
